claim: In 2026 the lock-in is 'taking over TikTok again', with a more holistic, mindfulness-inclusive focus ahead of 2027.
excerpt: Summary: TikTok has tens of thousands of videos documenting plans, routines and rules for the final stretch of 2026; goals range from fitness and saving money to reading and sleep; the 2026 version adds mindfulness and mental wellbeing.
title: The "Great Lock In" Is Taking Over TikTok Again – But What Is It, Exactly?
